field.description_en: The JSON path of the event field. Dot-notation nesting is supported
field.description_zh: 事件字段的 JSON 路径，支持点号嵌套
field.title: 字段

value.description_en: The matching value. Separate multiple values with commas when using IN or NOT_IN
value.description_zh: 匹配值，IN/NOT_IN 时逗号分隔多个值
value.title: 值

expression.description_en: Use either expression or relation. If expression is not empty, it takes precedence and relation is ignored. If expression is empty or not specified, relation (AND or OR) is used to perform a simple AND/OR operation on all conditions. Condition numbers correspond to the indexes of the conditions array (starting from 1). Each condition evaluates whether a single event field matches by using field (the event field path, which supports dot-notation nesting such as resource.tags.pod), op (the operator, such as CONTAIN, EQ, or IN), and value (the matching value)
expression.description_zh: expression 和 relation 二选一使用。如果 expression 非空，它优先生效，relation 被忽略；如果 expression 为空或不传，则用 relation（AND 或 OR）对所有条件做简单全量与/或运算。条件编号对应 conditions 数组的下标（从 1 开始），每个条件通过 field（事件字段路径，支持点号嵌套如 resource.tags.pod）、op（操作符，如 CONTAIN、EQ、IN 等）、value（匹配值）来评估单个事件字段是否匹配
expression.title: 表达式

relation.description_en: The logical relationship between conditions. This parameter takes effect when expression is empty
relation.description_zh: 条件间逻辑关系。expression 为空时生效
relation.title: 条件间关系

createTime.description_en: The time when the policy was created
createTime.title: 创建时间

dayInWeek.description_en: The days of the week when the policy is effective

items.description_en: The values 0 to 6 represent Sunday to Saturday

dayInWeek.title: 生效天(周一到周日)

enable.description_en: Indicates whether the policy is enabled
enable.title: 是否启用

endTime.description_en: The end time of the effective period
endTime.title: 生效结束时间

startTime.description_en: The start time of the effective period
startTime.title: 生效开始时间

updateTime.description_en: The last time the resource was updated
updateTime.title: 更新时间

description_en: Queries a list of silence policies
name: ListMaintainWindows

parameters.help_en: Policy Name of the silence policy. Fuzzy match is used (a match occurs if Policy Name contains the specified value). If you do not specify this parameter, results are not filtered by name
parameters.help_zh: 静默策略名称，模糊匹配（包含即命中）。不传表示不按名称过滤
parameters.name: maintain_window_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the silence policy. Exact match is used. If you do not specify this parameter, results are not filtered by ID
parameters.help_zh: 静默策略 ID，精确匹配。不传表示不按 ID 过滤
parameters.name: maintain_window_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters results by enabled status. Valid values:

true: Returns only enabled silence policies.
false: Returns only paused silence policies.

If you do not specify this parameter, results are not filtered by enabled status
parameters.help_zh:
按启用状态过滤。取值：

true：仅返回已启用的静默策略。
false：仅返回已暂停的静默策略。

不传表示不按启用状态过滤
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The workspace name. This parameter is required by the backend and is used to isolate silence policy resources across different business workspaces
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间名称。后端要求必填，用于隔离不同业务空间的静默策略资源
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the non-empty nextToken value returned in the previous response. This value does not guarantee that the next page contains data
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。首次查询无需传入；后续查询可传入上一次响应中的非空 nextToken。该值不保证下一页一定包含数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in this request. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录条数，默认值为 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction. Valid values:

asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order (default)
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值：

asc：正序。
desc：倒序（默认值）
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort results. Default value: createTime. Valid values:

createTime: creation time.
updateTime: update time.
enable: enabled status.

If you specify any other value, results are sorted by creation time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认按创建时间排序。取值：

createTime：创建时间。
updateTime：更新时间。
enable：是否启用。

传入其他值时按创建时间排序
parameters.name: order_by

maintainWindowList.description_en: The list of silence policies. An empty list is returned when no items match. The list items do not include workspaceFilterSetting
maintainWindowList.description_zh: 静默策略列表。没有匹配项时返回空列表；列表项不包含 workspaceFilterSetting

items.description_en: The silence policy details object. The fields have the same meanings as those in the maintainWindow object returned by GetMaintainWindow
items.description_zh: 静默策略详情对象，字段含义与 GetMaintainWindow 返回的 maintainWindow 一致

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records returned in this request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录条数
maxResults.title_en: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
maxResults.title_zh: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. A non-empty value indicates that more results may be available, but the next page may still be empty. An empty value indicates the end of pagination
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页起始游标。非空时可以继续查询，但下一页仍可能为空；为空表示分页结束

requestId.description_en: The unique ID of this request, used for troubleshooting and ticket tracking
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一 ID，用于问题排查与工单定位
